name: Deck of Knaves
text:
This 52-card deck has four suits of different clowns and jesters, with the back of the cards decorated in a yellow-and-blue harlequin pattern. If you have over half the deck in your possession, any lost cards reappear in it at dawn. You gain a +1 status bonus to Performance and Thievery checks when using these cards to entertain others.

Activate—Mesmerizing Shuffle 2 (illusion, manipulate, visual)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You shuffle the cards, creating a mirage that remain suspended around you for 1 minute, with the effects of Blur.
